headline: MCPGuard paper reports conformance gaps in official Model Context Protocol SDKs
summary: An arXiv preprint presents MCPGuard, a method that compares the Model Context Protocol specification with official SDK models and session logic, then checks candidate gaps with executable proof-of-concept tests. On Python SDK 1.26.0 and TypeScript SDK 1.29.0, the authors report 13 and 19 confirmed gaps, including 27 structural findings and five behavioral findings. They also report that two malformed URI-format metadata fields were accepted by all 32 public servers that completed the study’s handshake test. The authors say findings were privately reported to maintainers. These are paper-reported results, not an independent audit of current releases. ArXiv’s abstract page and Atom API date v1 to 12 August 2026, while its 4 November cs.AI new-submissions list includes the paper; why the listing contains it remains unresolved, so 4 November is not treated as the paper’s established first-publication date.
